seoTitle: Lazy Loading Injector: Add loading="lazy" to Images and Iframes
metaDescription: Paste HTML and get it back with native lazy loading added below the fold, early images left eager and a warning on lazy LCP images.
intro: Adds loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to images and iframes while leaving the first images eager.
why:
Native lazy loading saves data, but lazy-loading the main image delays it.

The tool leaves the first N images eager, removes loading="lazy" from them, can add fetchpriority="high" to the first one, and warns about lazy images without width and height. It edits only the tags and keeps the rest of your HTML as written.
